summary: Restrict member signatures to exact freshly sealed local envelopes

replay.detail: No historical signing or replay; retained unsigned envelopes remain stored unsigned.

schema.detail: No database schema changes or unsafe provenance backfill.

rules.detail: Activation and prepared sealing never sign retained own-labelled envelopes. Only exact freshly computed local envelope hashes are signed, atomically with sealing.

compatibility.detail: Unsigned historical authority stays held, including batches previously sealed by an unkeyed daemon. Ordinary Legacy replication and trusted-local issuance remain supported. Mixed versions were not exercised.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; restart duration is not measured.

manual.detail: Load admitted member signing credentials before creating replicated assistant grants. Review previously admitted grants separately; preserve the q32 freeze.

recovery.detail: Roll forward. Downgrading restores historical signature laundering; do not reset stores or disable signature verification.
